visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses and a khaki sweatshirt holds a massive wooden tray piled with various nigiri sushi, including salmon, tuna, and scallop. He has a wide-eyed, open-mouthed expression of shock and excitement. The setting is a brightly lit restaurant with wooden paneling. (2) Close-up shots show the man using chopsticks to eat a piece of sashimi and then a bowl of raw scallops. Yellow and white subtitles appear at the bottom. (3) The camera pans across a vertical promotional poster at the restaurant entrance, detailing an all-you-can-eat sushi deal with price tiers. (4) A fast-paced montage displays a buffet counter with trays of golden fried shrimp, fried chicken, onion rings, and large platters of scallops on ice. (5) Steam rises from a pot of miso soup, and a hand is shown picking up a bowl of it. (6) Visuals shift to a dessert and drink section with cakes, sliced pineapples, a refrigerator stocked with Coca-Cola and Sprite, and various Japanese ice cream bars in green and orange packaging. (7) A close-up of a tablet screen demonstrates the ordering interface, followed by shots of professional chefs in white hats preparing sushi and using a blowtorch to sear fish on the counter. (8) More food close-ups feature hand rolls, uni (sea urchin) sushi, and long pieces of grilled eel. (9) The man is seen eating enthusiastically, winking at the camera in a satisfied manner. (10) The final scene shows the mall interior with a crowd of people waiting outside the restaurant and a large text overlay displaying the store's address.
